method: Read the completed native-chart source report, verified the exact live owner identity while waiting, then directly viewed all 22 original root PNGs individually with tools.view_image(detail=original). No application, browser, model, simulation or test was launched or retried by this review.

scope: Visual layout and actual native offline/live/history chart screenshots from this bound r11 run only.
evidence_limitations: These are the 22 actual captured states, not exhaustive proof of every UI state or interaction.
Screenshot inspection does not establish satellite-model physical accuracy, AI raw benchmark accuracy or actual24h reliability.
Normalized offline/history curves compare per-variable trends, not different variables? absolute values; the recorded views disclose real ranges.
Views focused on a scrolled chart, legend or font controls do not claim every other page element is simultaneously in the viewport.
